Arch-Druid of the [[Moonglade]][https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Brothers_in_Blood_(WC3_NightElf) Brothers in Blood (WC3 NightElf)] | gender = Male | race = Night elf | level = ?? | type = Elite | creature = Humanoid | faction = Neutral | aggro = {{aggro|1|1}} | affiliation = [[Cenarion Circle]] | faffiliation = [[Kaldorei Empire]], [[Kaldorei resistance]] | occupation = Spiritual leader of the Kaldorei, Arch-Druid of the Moonglade | location = [[Emerald Dream]] | status = Alive | relatives = [[Tyrande Whisperwind]] (mate), [[Illidan Stormrage]] (twin brother) | mentors = [[Cenarius]] | students = [[Hamuul Runetotem]], [[Fandral Staghelm]], various other night elf druids }} '''Malfurion Stormrage''' is the greatest druid ever to live, and arguably one of the most powerful beings in history.[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Game_Manual#Night_elves World of Warcraft: Game Manual#Night elves] He stands as both prophet and savior to his people, having been the first night elf to oppose the evil Queen Azshara and her demon-worshiping highborne. He, along with his brother Illidan and the demi-god Cenarius, led the battle against the Burning Legion during the War of the Ancients. He was the first to forsake magic and adopt the tenets of druidism. He has been the spiritual leader of the night elves for over ten thousand years and has worked to safeguard his people's fragile culture – even from within the trance-like state of the Emerald Dream.[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Warcraft_III:_Reign_of_Chaos_Game_Manual#Malfurion_Stormrage Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos: Game Manual] Under the leadership of Tyrande and Malfurion, the night elves vanquished the Burning Legion not once, but twice. To replenish his powers, Malfurion periodically hibernates within the spirit realm known as the Emerald Dream. Recently something went wrong with Malfurion's dreamstate. Now he is trapped somewhere within the dream, beyond even the reach of the green dragons whose realm it is. With Malfurion lost, the night elves will certainly stumble into darkness, just as they have since time immemorial. ==Quests== * {{questlong|Neutral|60|Eranikus, Tyrant of the Dream (quest)|Eranikus, Tyrant of the Dream}} {{queststart}} ==Patch changes== * [[File:WoWlogo.png|40px]] '''Patch 1.2.0 (2004-12-18):''' Added. ==References== {{reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Stormrage, Malfurion}} [[Category:Night elf characters]] [[Category:Druid characters]] [[Category:Archdruids]] [[Category:Quest givers]] [[Category:Moonglade NPCs]] [[Category:Cenarion Circle]]
